text:
ashley: quick rollup from the postmortem — can owners confirm assignments + firm due dates? copying action list below, please reply with 'taking', 'reassign to @name', or 'blocked' + short reason.

1) Implement model-variant fallback routing in proxy (prevents 503s when a heavy model is OOM) — owner: TBD — proposed due: 2026-03-25
2) Add prefix/KV cache hit-rate metric + alert (critical for cost regressions) — owner: TBD — proposed due: 2026-03-22
3) Canary run and validation for quantized v2 build (perf + quality) — owner: TBD — proposed due: 2026-03-28
4) Update incident runbook: multi-region failover steps + automation playbook — owner: TBD — proposed due: 2026-03-20
5) Confirm Dedicated capacity SLA tests added to CI (load profile + degradation checks) — owner: TBD — proposed due: 2026-03-26

ashley: I'll ascribe initial owners based on folks at the meeting but want explicit confirmations:
- 1) mike
- 2) sara
- 3) raj
- 4) leo
- 5) mike

mike: taking 1) and 5). changing due for 5) to 2026-03-27 (need one extra day for test harness). blocked on eng-infra PR #478 for quota bump — ETA PR review by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sara: taking 2). can do 2026-03-22. note: dashboard needs a new tag in metrics pipeline (cc @raj for pipeline schema). I'll open a small RFC later today.

raj: ack. i'll review the metric schema change and own the pipeline side. not blocking sara. for 3) i can help with validation harness but not lead — reassign 3) to mike or leo? @mike @leo

mike: I can run the canary (3) but will need a test dataset from research. @sara can you export the eval set by EOD? if yes i keep 3) due 2026-03-28

sara: yes, will export eval set by EOD and share S3 path. assigning that to mike now.

leo: taking 4). I can target 2026-03-20 but need a quick review from security for runbook wording (two sentences). @ashley can you route to sec team? otherwise I'll slide to 2026-03-22.

ashley: routing to security now. incidents-bot: created task INCIDENT-2026-119 and pinged sec on Slack channel #eng-security. 

incidents-bot: Task INCIDENT-2026-119 created (runbook update). Assigned: leo. Notified: #eng-security. Status: open.

raj: small dependency note — prefix/KV cache metric (2) depends on the new exporter lib in infra that lands next week. if infra delays, push 2) by 3 days. I'll add a dependency tag in the task.

mike: confirmed for 1,3,5. final due dates I have: 1) 2026-03-25, 3) 2026-03-28, 5) 2026-03-27. filing follow-up tasks and PRs later today.

ashley: perfect — summary: confirmed owners + dates: 1(mike)-03/25, 2(sara+raj)-03/22, 3(mike)-03/28, 4(leo)-03/20 (pending sec), 5(mike)-03/27. I'll update the postmortem checklist and set reminders. If anyone needs to reassign, do so in this thread. Thanks all. :pray:
